description: This file contains a PHP class called Download within the namespace Opencart.Admin.Controller.Catalog. It defines various methods for handling downloading of files, listing downloads, pagination, form display, and saving download data in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class extends the system engine Controller and interacts with models, views, and other system components to manage downloadable items in the catalog section.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Controller class for managing product downloads in the admin catalog, including listing, form handling, and save operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load the download management page, including breadcrumbs, list of downloads, and view rendering.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Method that sets up data and returns the listings of downloads using the getList method.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Protected method that retrieves the list of downloads with sorting, ordering, and pagination filters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a download, including download details and linked files.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a download record, including permission checks, validation, and model interaction.
